label: Skin & Body Regions — Review Preview
alt: Adult male surface anatomy with 250 individually selectable skin-region patches over aligned muscles, tendons and skeleton. Remove a selected surface region to reveal anatomy beneath it, or hide a skin-area layer. Search and text study provide keyboard access.
reviewNote: Surface anatomy preview. Remove a selected patch to reveal underlying muscles and skeleton; use Restore to replace it. Left/right refer to the subject. Source surface boundaries and draft course synonyms await instructor review.

structureGroups.label: Tendons & bands (36)
structureGroups.description: Separate tendon structures, retinacula, and connective bands. Tendon regions within muscles stay with their parent muscle.

structureGroups.label: Fascia & connective tissues (67)
structureGroups.description: Fascia, aponeuroses and eyelid tarsal plates at 30% opacity.
